g.text: Payment Flow: Atomic Intent, Processor Call, Outbox-Relayed Webhook
Record intent locally first -- a crash after that point is always recoverable, never ambiguous
If the process crashes right after step 2 (calling the processor) but
before step 3 commits, payment_intents already holds a 'pending' row --
never an unknown state. The reconciliation job queries the processor's
own status API for any intent stuck in 'processing' past a threshold.
